title: GNSS Log Stats: local-only descriptive statistics for GNSS CSV logs
description:
GNSS Log Stats is a small, dependency-free Python command-line tool that summarizes an approved GNSS CSV log as JSON: record count, UTC time span, latitude/longitude ranges and means, optional altitude, speed, satellite-count and HDOP summaries, and counts of recognized fix types.

It streams the CSV one record at a time, validates explicit-UTC timestamps, coordinate ranges and numeric fields, rejects malformed rows, and never echoes arbitrary input text or unrecognized fix labels in its output. It runs locally and makes no network requests.

Scope: descriptive statistics only. It does not infer signal conditions, validate a receiver, or establish physical evidence. GNSS logs can reveal sensitive location history; no real logs are included, and the tests use in-memory sample data.

Python 3.10+, standard library only. 20 unittest tests run in GitHub Actions on Python 3.10-3.14. License: AGPL-3.0-only.
